rationale: "2010" in "Microsoft Office 2010" identifies the product name, not a date anchor for the question, so per the reading policy the deictic "latest" resolves against audit_as_of (2026-07-21), giving direction=current. Evidence (e1, s2) shows the frozen answer 14.0.7182.5000 (KB4023935, released June 13, 2017) was a valid current-version answer prior to the reference time. Evidence (e1, s1, s3) shows Office 2010's final build, 14.0.7261.5000, was released October 13, 2020 — the same day Office 2010 support ended — and is now documented as "the most current version." This later revision supersedes the frozen answer, which is no longer the latest version at audit time.
